idea-plugin.name: Merge Hell Runner
idea-plugin.description:
The build is red. The deadline is tonight. Your only escape is to run.

Merge Hell Runner is a full-blown, side-scrolling action game that lives inside your IntelliJ IDEA tool window. Stop fixing merge conflicts — outrun them. Turn every NullPointerException, every 3am on-call page, and every 800-line legacy class into a boss you can finally shoot back at.


🔥 Escape the Merge Hell 🔥

A complete 5-level campaign of cyberpunk parkour, arena survival, and boss brawls — playable in the time it takes your CI pipeline to fail again.


🚀 What's inside v1.0.0:

  • 🗺️ 5 Distinct Missions: Run from Repository City to the Heap District, Blueprint Citadel, Kernel Core, and the reality-bending Singularity Edge.
  • 👹 5 Unique Bosses: Break the dependency graph of the Legacy Code Monstrosity, then face the Memory Leak Daemon, The Architect, Kernel Panic Overlord, and the adaptive Singularity Engine.
  • 🧬 Level-Specific Enemies: Fight heap leaks, scope sentinels, ring-0 interrupts, and mirrors that converge in the finale.
  • 🌊 Arena Battle Zones: Get locked in and survive relentless enemy waves — Rush, Sniper and Mini-Boss formations that don't respect clean code.
  • 🔫 6-Weapon Arsenal: Blast bugs with git push, spread-fire git push -f, rapid git commit -a, the devastating rm -rf /, flaming git blaze, and the screen-clearing sudo rm -rf / laser.
  • ⚡ Sudo Mode & Power-Ups: Grab the Golden Thunderbolt for ROOT ACCESS, equip Shields to tank a fatal crash, and snag health to stay in the fight.
  • 🪙 Coins & Local Leaderboard: Collect coins mid-run and chase your Top 5 high scores, saved right in your IDE.
  • 🏃 Tight Platforming: Double-jump, dash through danger with i-frames, and rack up a combo multiplier for style points.
  • 🎨 Retro Visuals: CRT scanlines, parallax code rain, floating combat text, and juicy damage numbers.

"The only plugin where rm -rf / is a valid survival strategy."


Crafted with ❤️, ☕ and a lot of git merge --abort by Phil Zhang.
Check out my portfolio: phil-the-guy.netlify.app
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v1.0.0 — First Stable Release 🎉

Merge Hell Runner is now a complete five-mission campaign with a distinct world, enemy ecosystem, and boss encounter for every chapter.

  • NEW: Five visually distinct missions: Repository City, Heap District, Blueprint Citadel, Kernel Core, and Singularity Edge.
  • NEW: Five handcrafted bosses with unique phase rules, attacks, silhouettes, and encounter HUDs.
  • NEW: Level-specific enemy families: Leak, Sentinel, Interrupt, and Mirror.
  • NEW: Arena Battle Zones with wave-based combat (Rush / Sniper / Mini-Boss).
  • NEW: Six-weapon arsenal, including the Flame and Laser weapons.
  • NEW: Coin collection and a persistent local Top-5 leaderboard.
  • NEW: Platforming layer with dash i-frames, double jump, and combo multipliers.
  • FIXED: Cleared arenas no longer restart, Lab boss shortcuts work in every mission, and mission-complete screens remain readable before the next level begins.
